href.description: Link target for the avatar image.

src.description: Image source URL for the avatar image variant.

alt.description: Accessible label for the avatar. Used as image alt text or non-image avatar aria-label.

value.description: Value for non-image avatars. Initials text when variant='initials', icon name when variant='icon'.

shape.description: Optional shape utility for avatar image or initials.

tooltipProps.description: Optional Tooltip props passed through unchanged. The Avatar supplies the trigger element.

className.description: Additional classes for the avatar link element.

imageClassName.description: Additional classes for the avatar image element.

contentClassName.description: Additional classes for the non-image avatar content container.
